title: Gallery — three images in one lesson
description: Stacks three image sections inside a single lesson — useful as a sanity check that consecutive image widgets render with consistent spacing and don't share state.

data.markdown: Three images, three figure captions, no source code. Each section is independent — the widgets do not share keys, so collapse-state and progress flags are tracked per section.

data.caption: Cameraman.jpg — MIT Lincoln Laboratory test image, 256×256 grayscale. Often used to demonstrate edge detection.
Lena.jpg — frequently used test image with mixed smooth and high-frequency content.
noise-test.png — synthetic uniform white noise, useful as an extreme-frequency-content control alongside the natural-image test set.
